purpose: LegalHigh Apple-style material and motion completion audit
discipline: Curated verification record; URLs remain authoritative. Excerpts are intentionally short and are not represented as full raw snapshots.

sources.title: Human Interface Guidelines — Materials
verified_facts: Liquid Glass forms a functional layer for controls and navigation.
Apple says not to use Liquid Glass in the content layer.
Material selection should follow semantic meaning and recommended usage.

sources.title: SwiftUI Spring
verified_facts: Spring(duration: 0.5, bounce: 0.3) maps to mass 1.0, stiffness 157.9 and damping 17.6.
dampingRatio is the drag fraction relative to critical damping.

sources.title: Animate with springs — WWDC23 Session 10158
verified_facts: Apple describes continuous position and velocity as goals for natural motion.
Apple recommends caution above roughly 0.4 bounce for UI elements.
sources.correction: The former 10161 link was incorrect; 10161 is an Inspectors in SwiftUI session.

sources.title: overflow
verified_facts: hidden overflow can still create a programmatically scrollable container.
clip overflow is not a scroll container and cannot be programmatically scrolled.
clip must not hide interactive content that keyboard users need to reach.

sources.title: overscroll-behavior
verified_facts: contain prevents scroll chaining to neighboring scrolling areas.

sources.title: linear(), scroll-driven animations, and backdrop-filter
sources.evidence_grade: 强（语法）/中（跨浏览器渲染推断）
verified_facts: linear() can approximate complex easing curves and represent values outside 0–1.
scroll-driven animations use a scroll-based rather than time-based timeline.
backdrop-filter accepts filter functions and URL filter references, subject to browser support.
